applicabilityBasis.summary: wM is a non-rebasing 1:1 wrapper around M and presents dollar-stable transfer and unwrap functionality, so it is treated as an apparent payment stablecoin even though the wrapper is not the underlying M minter.

genius.issuerEntity: M0 Foundation / M0 protocol; underlying M is minted by permissioned Minters
genius.notes: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception was found for wM, M0 Foundation, or the underlying M token. M0 describes an issuer-partner infrastructure model, so a future GENIUS posture may attach to an individual permissioned Minter rather than to the wrapper or protocol layer.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-08-14, no token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception was found for wM, M0 Foundation, or the underlying M token. The public M0 materials describe infrastructure and permissioned issuer partners, not a wM-specific U.S. authorization.
